method: box 40x30x20 with its top front edge (y=0, z=20) rounded at a radius that is a clamped cubic B-spline in u = x/40, knots 0,0,0,0,0.25,0.6,1,1,1,1, control radii 2, 5, 1.5, 4, 1, 3 (r(0) = 2, r(40) = 3). The round is the union of the balls rolled along the edge, ball s touching both faces at r(s), the law continued past the edge's ends along its end slopes: each section loses the corner points no ball reaches, up to rho(x, t), the nearest entry into a ball along the ray from the edge at the angle t. V, moments and areas integrated by Gauss-Legendre panels in x and t, per knot span
